name: electricistaadomicilio.com.ar
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But no content security policy.
lesson: Tighten the content security policy one directive at a time, starting from default-src 'self'.
summary: electricistaadomicilio.com.ar scores 91 out of 100 (A). 0 checks fail now, 13 are at risk, and 42 pass. Fix first: no content security policy.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: A window the page opens, or that opens it, keeps a handle to it, which tabnabbing and cross-site leaks use. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin-allow-popups, or same-origin when the site opens no sign-in or payment popup.

fix.title: No Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site
fix.evidence: AI answers lean on this to name the brand, its logo, and its profiles. The page links 1 profile that could go in sameAs.
fix.fix: Add Organization (or Person) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs. The fix kit has a draft.

fix.title: No privacy notice is linked
fix.evidence: None of the 20 pages analyzed, nor the rendered start page, links a privacy notice, yet the site loads Cloudflare Web Analytics. Visitors cannot see who handles their data or why.
fix.fix: Publish a privacy notice that names who controls the data, what is collected, why, and the visitor's rights, and link it from the footer of every page.

fix.title: Visits from Google Maps are not told apart in analytics
fix.evidence: The profile's website link has no UTM tags, so analytics counts a tap on Website in Maps as an ordinary Google search or a direct visit.
fix.fix: Add utm_source=google&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=business-profile to the profile's website link.

fix.title: No llms.txt was found
fix.evidence: /llms.txt returned 404. It is a proposed convention that some AI tools read to find the pages that matter.
fix.fix: Publish /llms.txt. The fix kit has a draft built from this review.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 366 ms
Every external link that was checked answered
